description: A 3HP expander for Vektor, placed immediately to its right: it brings the two LFOs, the joystick position and the mix envelope out as seven voltages.

outputs.text: Carries that LFO from Vektor as a -5V to +5V voltage; with the LFO switched off the jack holds 0V and its LED turns red
Reports the position of Vektor's physical joystick along that axis as a -5V to +5V voltage, taking no account of the X and Y input jacks or of the mix envelope
Goes to +10V while Vektor's mix envelope is running and 0V otherwise
Reports the mix envelope's position along that axis as a -5V to +5V voltage while the envelope runs; with the envelope off the jack holds 0V and all three lower LEDs turn red

notes: the expander works only when it touches the right edge of a Vektor module. With no link made, all seven LEDs blink red quickly.
the envelope outputs leave out any offset from the joystick or from the X and Y input jacks.
this expander has no menu of its own, and no controls; it takes its panel model from the Vektor it is attached to.
